investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Maplefield Telecom (mobile operator); Platform: AWS ca-central-1 (zones ca-central-1a/ca-central-1b/ca-central-1d); network range 10.104.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster maplef-prod-cacent (EKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic number-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer number-porting-svc, consumer plan-catalog; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
